name: Hacettepe University
notes: Wikidata P18 empty, automated retry confirmed no_candidate. Manual: took 4 attempts to find a usable candidate. Rejected in order: (1) 'Hacettepe Üniversitesi kampüs servisleri.jpg' - turned out on inspection to be a close-up photo of the university's logo decal on a shuttle bus, i.e. it IS a logo, not a campus photo, despite being filed under a plausible-sounding 'campus shuttle services' name; (2) 'Hacettepe Üniversitesi, Beytepe Kampüsü 02.jpg' - despite the Beytepe-campus filename, the actual photo content is a distant Ankara skyline view with no identifiable building; (3) a numbered 'Beytepe Kampüsü (24.08.2024)' file that turned out to be an unrelated park/garden scene with a decorative sculpture, no building. Finally found Category:Hacettepe University Faculty of Engineering and picked 'Hacettepe Üniversitesi, Beytepe Kampüsü, Mühendislik Fakültesi, 2020.jpg' - real photo of a building with a visible sign reading 'KİMYA MÜHENDİSLİĞİ BÖLÜMÜ' (Chemistry Engineering Department), a real Hacettepe University department building. Notable case for other workers: don't trust a Commons filename alone when it contains generic words like 'kampüs'/'campus' - the top-level and Beytepe-level categories here are full of logo/skyline/garden photos misfiled next to genuine building photos, so each candidate needs an actual view before being trusted, not just a plausible-sounding title. 3648x2736, ratio 1.33.
